title: rsim's jumps checked in Lean: no halt in 2·10<sup>14</sup> and 8·10<sup>15</sup> steps
text: The accelerated simulator rsim, rebuilt in Lean with every move proved (tools/lean/TM/RSim.lean): its learned crossing rules are checked by runs of the machine, and each sample-level jump by one symbolic period with the counts as linear forms. Evaluated with native_decide, it shows that 1RB0LC_1RC1RA_1RD0RF_0LE---_1LA1LE_0RA1RF does not halt in its first 2·1014 steps (2 minutes) and 1RB0RF_0LC---_1LD1LC_1RE0LA_1RA1RD_0RD1RF not in its first 8·1015 (5 minutes). The unchecked C++ runs went to 1.2·1020 and 1.8·1017.
